# Visitor rules

## The gallery

The gallery is open between ten and four. At most six visitors may stand on it
at once, and a keeper counts them up the stairs. Dogs are not allowed above the
first landing.

## The lamp room

The lamp room is closed to visitors. No flash photography is allowed on the
stairs, because the flash blinds the keeper on watch.

## Refreshments

Visitors can buy coffee at the café in the old boathouse. The café closes at
three, an hour before the gallery does, so that the last visitors are not
left on the stairs in the dark.
